column1: # Rule: PR, merge-queue and main gate jobs never fetch tools or deps from the network.
# Every network site in this repo is listed here with its class and reason.
# class: release = runs only on tag/release/dispatch, never on pull_request, merge_group or push-to-main
#        local   = developer Makefile/script hint or recipe, never invoked by a workflow
#        text    = message string or comment, not an executed fetch
# Verified: ci.yml and pr-gate.yml contain no curl, wget, cargo install, install-action, setup-* or pip/npm install.
